headline: Jauan Jennings Just Bought Kyle a Playoff Spot in Week 3
subhead: Put an AR to My Head dropped 186 on the Jets' Juniors and somewhere a third-string Vikings WR became a fantasy deity.
matchOfTheWeek: MassiveCocks 112.74 vs 226 Alpha 109.18 was the only matchup this week that didn't look like a bar fight at last call. Two teams sleepwalking to a combined 221 points and Papi escapes by 3.56 because Szara apparently forgot the games were on Sunday. Nobody won, the league just lost.
powerRankingsShakeup: Put an AR to My Head rockets up the board after a 186-burger, while Jets' Juniors free-fall into 'why did I draft this' territory despite Henry and Dak both going nuclear. Bo Nix Celli also tumbles for the cardinal sin of leaving a Honda Civic worth of points on the bench.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the war crime. Kyle hung 186.96 on Wunder, and the smoking gun is Jauan Jennings — yes, JAUAN JENNINGS — going for FORTY-SIX POINTS while Saquon stacked another 33.6 on top. That's not a fantasy lineup, that's a ransom note. Wunder didn't even play badly — Henry 30, Dak 29 — he just walked into a buzzsaw with Malik Willis (25.38!) rotting on his bench like forgotten leftovers. Tough scene.

Meanwhile, Bo Nix Celli managed to score 127 AND lose by 25 AND leave 47.14 points on the bench. Read that again. Chuba Hubbard put up 27.9 in street clothes for Nick. That's a triple-threat of incompetence — losing the matchup, losing to your own bench, and losing my respect. Cubby cruises behind a 32-spot from Dallas Goedert, which is the most Dallas Goedert sentence ever written.

T Swift's Baddies dropped 165 on Hot Cocks in a game where BigD got 29.8 from Ja'Marr Chase AND left Diontae Johnson's 26.2 on the bench. You scored 142 and still got blown out — that's not bad luck, that's a skill issue.

The Good Ladds got Josh Allen for 30.92 and STILL lost by 23 because Cole Kmet decided to drop 30.7 from the bench. Mig, starting Kmet would've been the difference. Read the room. Stroud Boys ride Kyren's 31.6 to a clean win.

LargestofRocks handled Patrick despite McLaurin (20) collecting splinters, and MassiveCocks survived the Slap Fight Bowl against 226 Alpha, who earned the league-low 109 trophy. Szara, your team scored less than Jennings and Saquon combined. Marinate on that.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Mob Boss
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 47 points on the pine and still has the audacity to log into Sleeper on Tuesdays.

weeklyAwards.blurb: League-low 109 in a week where six guys cleared 140 — congrats on showing up, I guess.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Josh Allen drops 30.92 and Mig still loses because Cole Kmet was apparently in witness protection on his bench.
